newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bertelsmann 96/97 oper profit 1.6 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: Bertelsmann 96/97 oper profit 1.6 bln DM.

text.p: German media group Bertelsmann AG posted an operating profit of 1.6 billion marks ($910.5 million) in the year to June 30, chief executive Mark Woessner said.

"In 1996/97 we were better than in the year before. I don't know any media company in the world that is doing better," Woessner said in an interview with the news magazine Der Spiegel to be published on Monday.
But Wossner said he could not be completely satisfied since the company had not met its target for the year, partly because of enormous start-up losses at television affiliate CLT-Ufa.
Bertelsmann posted an operating profit of 1.53 billion marks in 1995/96, down from 1.665 billion the year before. Its net profit was 905 million, up from 817 million.
The Spiegel report was released to the media ahead of publication.
-- Terence Gallagher, Bonn newsroom, 49-228-26097150 ($ = 1.757 German Marks)
